same_source_control.interpretation: The identical-source six-case mix varies by about 0.3-8.5%; this does not quantitatively explain or waive the larger full-matrix shifts. No ratios were subtracted and no samples were discarded.

evidence.contents: Complete experiment summaries, raw timing samples, numerical comparison results and hashes of full worker arrays. Actual full-vector workers/HLO remain under ignored results and are reproducible from retained source archives and tooling.

limitations: Same-process native measurements show faster batches, while the independent full workload mix records 17 warmed flags, including unchanged-code controls. The larger context discrepancy remains unresolved.
Complete 22-property PG states, real status outputs and bicubic whole-core checks remain. Numerical-only and packed-status diagnostics do not replace the acceptance workloads.

One obsolete private test spy failed in the full run. A test-only forwarding repair and the complete five-test module rerun establish an audited 3,027-case verified union; the original failed execution remains recorded.
Results cover CPU/x64 and installed HEOS/REFPROP. GPU and ThermOpt integration results are not inferred.
